source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.quote: Through the agreement, Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine.
source.note: League-wide branding on all BAL uniforms, not a club-level shirt deal. On Club Africain's white 2026 BAL jersey VISIT RWANDA is printed on the front below the number (BAL/PUMA launch imagery; SportBusiness.tn photo 'Maillot PUMA du Club africain - BAL 2026': https://www.sportbusiness.tn/puma-bal-club-africain/).

source.name: Basketball Africa League (via APO Group): Basketball Africa League Names PUMA as League's Official Outfitter Ahead of 2026 Season
source.quote: will see PUMA supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms
source.note: League-wide outfitter for the 2026 BAL season; the Puma chest logo is on Club Africain's white 2026 BAL jersey (SportBusiness.tn photo 'Maillot PUMA du Club africain - BAL 2026': https://www.sportbusiness.tn/puma-bal-club-africain/).

summary: League-designed 2026 BAL uniform made by PUMA (league outfitter, chest logo) with league-wide Visit Rwanda branding on the front below the number. No club-level shirt sponsor found for the 2026 BAL season; only front views of the jersey have been published, so back, sleeve and shorts placements are unchecked.
